Definition: from the base of G3425; toil, i.e. (by implication) sadness:--painfulness, travail.
BiblicalUsage: Mochthos is toil, hard labour. Paul reminds the Thessalonians that he worked night and day so he would not burden them, and he lists weariness and painfulness among the marks of his apostleship.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Paul's toil is the shape of love that refuses to be a burden. He works with his hands so the gospel comes free.
